enabled.description: Enable or disable the mptcpd daemon at boot.

path_manager.description: Path manager plugin to load (e.g., addr_adv, subflow). Must match a plugin filename in plugin-dir.

log_target.description: Logging target: stderr, syslog, journal, or null.

log_level.description: Verbosity of logging. Options: debug, info, notice, warning, error, critical. Lower levels = more verbose.

log_file.description: Path to write log output (e.g., /var/log/mptcpd.log). If empty, logs only to stderr.

allowed_interfaces.description: List of network interfaces allowed for MPTCP path management. Each interface can be enabled/disabled and assigned a priority.

socket_opts.description: Optional low-level socket options for MPTCP connections (e.g., mptcp.nodelay, net.ipv4.tcp_congestion_control). Use only if you understand MPTCP internals.

custom_paths.description: Override default routing for specific destinations (e.g., force all traffic to a subnet via a specific interface).
